question: I've sketched a rectangle over Midtown Manhattan running from longitude -74.00 to -73.97 and latitude 40.75 to 40.77. Which taxi zones overlap that rectangle, and for each one, how many taxi trips in January 2024 picked up passengers there?
sql: WITH study_box AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.00, 40.75, -73.97, 40.77) AS env), jan_pickups AS (SELECT PULocationID AS zone_id, COUNT(*) AS pickups FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' GROUP BY PULocationID) SELECT z.zone, z.borough, COALESCE(p.pickups, 0) AS january_pickups FROM nyc_taxi_zones z CROSS JOIN study_box LEFT JOIN jan_pickups p ON p.zone_id = z.location_id WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, study_box.env) ORDER BY january_pickups DESC, z.zone

question: For each borough, picture the smallest rectangle that encloses all of its taxi zones. Which pairs of boroughs end up with rectangles that overlap one another? List each pair only once.
sql: WITH borough_boxes AS (SELECT borough, ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS env FROM nyc_taxi_zones GROUP BY borough) SELECT a.borough AS borough_a, b.borough AS borough_b FROM borough_boxes a JOIN borough_boxes b ON a.borough < b.borough AND a.env && b.env ORDER BY borough_a, borough_b

question: In January 2024 some riders tipped more than 50 dollars. Take every zone where such a trip began: what single rectangle encloses all of those zones? I'd like the rectangle's outline so I can plot it myself, plus how big it is in square kilometres.
sql: WITH big_tip_pickups AS (SELECT z.geometry FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE t.tip_amount > 50 AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'), envelope AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS env FROM big_tip_pickups) SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(env) AS envelope_geojson, ROUND(ST_Area_Spheroid(env) / 1000000.0, 1) AS envelope_area_sq_km FROM envelope

question: Draw the tightest rectangle around every taxi zone in Staten Island, and a second one around every taxi zone in Manhattan. Measured at their closest points, how many kilometres separate those two rectangles?
sql: WITH borough_boxes AS (SELECT borough, ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS env FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough IN ('Staten Island', 'Manhattan') GROUP BY borough) SELECT ROUND(ST_Distance(ST_Transform(si.env, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32618', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(ma.env, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32618', always_xy := true)) / 1000.0, 2) AS gap_km FROM borough_boxes si JOIN borough_boxes ma ON ma.borough = 'Manhattan' WHERE si.borough = 'Staten Island'

question: Lower and mid-Manhattan south of 96th Street fits inside the rectangle between longitude -74.03 and -73.94 and latitude 40.70 to 40.78. In January 2024, how many taxi trips both began and ended in zones overlapping that rectangle, and what was the average total fare across those trips?
sql: WITH downtown AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.03, 40.70, -73.94, 40.78) AS env), qualifying_trips AS (SELECT t.total_amount FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pz ON t.PULocationID = pz.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones dz ON t.DOLocationID = dz.location_id CROSS JOIN downtown WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND ST_Intersects(pz.geometry, downtown.env) AND ST_Intersects(dz.geometry, downtown.env)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips_both_ends_inside, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total_fare FROM qualifying_trips

question: In January 2024, some taxi trips started right at the JFK Airport zone. Of those trips, how many finished in a taxi zone that fits completely inside the rectangle enclosing every Manhattan zone?
sql: WITH manhattan_box AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS env FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough = 'Manhattan'), jfk_zone AS (SELECT location_id FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE zone = 'JFK Airport') SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips_ending_inside_manhattan_box FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN jfk_zone ON t.PULocationID = jfk_zone.location_id JOIN nyc_taxi_zones dz ON t.DOLocationID = dz.location_id CROSS JOIN manhattan_box WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND dz.geometry @ manhattan_box.env
